captureType: Flutter headless app runner with widget-test API; RenderRepaintBoundary capture
productionWidget: ReadingTabsSidePanel and its real vertical tab strip
readerContent: Neutral sample document; no personal data
theme: AppThemeData light/dark with each default AppSeedColors seed

fonts.ui: Bundled Rubik loaded as Roboto and host default font-family aliases; normal Linux font fallback enabled for unspecified families
fonts.icons: Actual FluentSystemIcons Regular and Filled assets

verified: Reader Rect is exactly equal before and after hover in both themes
Persistent expansion is activated through the actual header button
reproduction: Copy capture_4092_test.dart into test/_capture_4092_test.dart in the repository checkout.
Use Flutter 3.47.7 and run the command recorded in runCommand. The default SCREENSHOT_OUTPUT, if omitted, is build/qa4092.
Use flutter run -d flutter-tester: flutter test forces a test font for unspecified font families, which would replace Hebrew tab titles with boxes.
After All tests passed, press q to terminate the headless app. Remove the temporary test source afterwards.
